name: Esu
source:
With a strong drive to take on new challenges, Esu has a lively personality, full of energy. He's always restless, moving and talking non-stop, but he loves adventures and is in many ways, versatile.

He is a member of NEW DIMENSION's Special for Princess! and serves as the leader. He's looking forward to the adventures he'll be embarking on within the new environment of being an idol and is hoping to discover his own identity as an idol.

[Translated from [url=https://ensemble-stars.jp/characters/esu/]official website[/url]]
